title: Force fields bending light seen in the Navy tic tac video

tellings.quote: >> The force fields interact with light when when when you see and you can see it on the tic tac video. the Navy pilots.

plain: The force fields around alien craft bend light, and you can see this in the Navy's Tic Tac video, according to Charles Hall, who says he spent three years with tall white aliens at Area 51, a secret Air Force test site in Nevada. The video he means is a 2004 Navy infrared recording of a white oval object shaped like the mint, filmed by Navy pilots. Hall tells Michels that 'the force fields interact with light' and that this shows on the footage, which would mean the video captures the same technology he says he saw.
